title: Watch LE SSERAFIM Bring ‘Made My Night’ to ‘The Jennifer Hudson Show’ & Tease Their U.S. Tour
summary: The K-pop stars opened up about their Overwatch collaboration, their upcoming tour and their favorite American snack.
contentText:
LE SSERAFIM brought the group’s late-night energy to daytime television on Tuesday (Sept. 15), performing new single “Made My Night” on  The Jennifer Hudson Show .

Related

LE SSERAFIM to Perform ‘Boompala’ After Fever vs. Mercury Game for First-Ever WNBA Edition of ‘In the Paint’: Watch a Preview

KATSEYE, LE SSERFIM and ILLIT Come Together For Digital Single ‘Iconic By Mistake’

Bathed in playful neon lighting, Sakura, Kim Chaewon, Huh Yunjin, Kazuha and Hong Eunchae looked like they were having just as much fun as the song suggests as they danced their way through the upbeat track. The performance comes just days after the group released “Made My Night,” which is LE SSERAFIM’s latest collaboration with  Overwatch after “Perfect Night” in 2023 for Overwatch 2 .

“Made My Night” captures the excitement of meeting someone special and wanting the night to keep going — a sentiment that came through in the group’s bright, energetic performance. “You just made my night, I’m feeling better now,” they sing in the chorus, before declaring, “Let’s not go home, let’s keep on dancing.”

After the performance, Hudson invited the group to stick around for a round of questions from some of their biggest fans. The members revealed a few entertaining tidbits about themselves, including who gives the best — and worst — advice, as well as what their favorite American snacks are. When multiple members named popcorn as their favorite, Hudson gifted the group some bags of the snack for their expected traveling for their U.S. tour.

LE SSERAFIM teased the upcoming U.S. tour through promising “special surprises” and performances and looks that fans will enjoy, while keeping most of the details under wraps. The trek is set to kick off on Wednesday (Sept. 16) at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles.
